data="-%20name%3A%20gpu%0A%20%20description%3A%20%7C%0A%20%20%20%20How%20to%20distribute%20the%20work%20to%20your%20GPUs.%20See%20%7B%40link%20GPUSetting%7D%20for%20more%20information.%0A%20%20public%3A%20true%0A%20%20type%3A%20GPUSetting%0A%20%20optional%3A%20true%0A%0A-%20name%3A%20contextLength%0A%20%20description%3A%20%7C%0A%20%20%20%20The%20size%20of%20the%20context%20length%20in%20number%20of%20tokens.%20This%20will%20include%20both%20the%20prompts%20and%20the%0A%20%20%20%20responses.%20Once%20the%20context%20length%20is%20exceeded%2C%20the%20value%20set%20in%0A%20%20%20%20%7B%40link%20LLMPredictionConfigBase%23contextOverflowPolicy%7D%20is%20used%20to%20determine%20the%20behavior.%0A%0A%20%20%20%20See%20%7B%40link%20LLMContextOverflowPolicy%7D%20for%20more%20information.%0A%20%20type%3A%20number%0A%20%20optional%3A%20true%0A%0A-%20name%3A%20ropeFrequencyBase%0A%20%20description%3A%20%7C%0A%20%20%20%20Custom%20base%20frequency%20for%20rotary%20positional%20embeddings%20(RoPE).%0A%0A%20%20%20%20This%20advanced%20parameter%20adjusts%20how%20positional%20information%20is%20embedded%20in%20the%20model's%0A%20%20%20%20representations.%20Increasing%20this%20value%20may%20enable%20better%20performance%20at%20high%20context%20lengths%20by%0A%20%20%20%20modifying%20how%20the%20model%20processes%20position-dependent%20information.%0A%20%20type%3A%20number%0A%20%20optional%3A%20true%0A%0A-%20name%3A%20ropeFrequencyScale%0A%20%20description%3A%20%7C%0A%20%20%20%20Scaling%20factor%20for%20RoPE%20(Rotary%20Positional%20Encoding)%20frequency.%0A%0A%20%20%20%20This%20factor%20scales%20the%20effective%20context%20window%20by%20modifying%20how%20positional%20information%20is%0A%20%20%20%20encoded.%20Higher%20values%20allow%20the%20model%20to%20handle%20longer%20contexts%20by%20making%20positional%20encoding%0A%20%20%20%20more%20granular%2C%20which%20can%20be%20particularly%20useful%20for%20extending%20a%20model%20beyond%20its%20original%0A%20%20%20%20training%20context%20length.%0A%20%20type%3A%20number%0A%20%20optional%3A%20true%0A%0A-%20name%3A%20evalBatchSize%0A%20%20description%3A%20%7C%0A%20%20%20%20Number%20of%20input%20tokens%20to%20process%20together%20in%20a%20single%20batch%20during%20evaluation.%0A%0A%20%20%20%20Increasing%20this%20value%20typically%20improves%20processing%20speed%20and%20throughput%20by%20leveraging%0A%20%20%20%20parallelization%2C%20but%20requires%20more%20memory.%20Finding%20the%20optimal%20batch%20size%20often%20involves%0A%20%20%20%20balancing%20between%20performance%20gains%20and%20available%20hardware%20resources.%0A%20%20type%3A%20number%0A%20%20optional%3A%20true%0A%0A-%20name%3A%20flashAttention%0A%20%20description%3A%20%7C%0A%20%20%20%20Enables%20Flash%20Attention%20for%20optimized%20attention%20computation.%0A%0A%20%20%20%20Flash%20Attention%20is%20an%20efficient%20implementation%20that%20reduces%20memory%20usage%20and%20speeds%20up%0A%20%20%20%20generation%20by%20optimizing%20how%20attention%20mechanisms%20are%20computed.%20This%20can%20significantly%0A%20%20%20%20improve%20performance%20on%20compatible%20hardware%2C%20especially%20for%20longer%20sequences.%0A%20%20type%3A%20boolean%0A%20%20optional%3A%20true%0A%0A-%20name%3A%20keepModelInMemory%0A%20%20description%3A%20%7C%0A%20%20%20%20When%20enabled%2C%20prevents%20the%20model%20from%20being%20swapped%20out%20of%20system%20memory.%0A%0A%20%20%20%20This%20option%20reserves%20system%20memory%20for%20the%20model%20even%20when%20portions%20are%20offloaded%20to%20GPU%2C%0A%20%20%20%20ensuring%20faster%20access%20times%20when%20the%20model%20needs%20to%20be%20used.%20Improves%20performance%0A%20%20%20%20particularly%20for%20interactive%20applications%2C%20but%20increases%20overall%20RAM%20requirements.%0A%20%20type%3A%20boolean%0A%20%20optional%3A%20true%0A%0A-%20name%3A%20seed%0A%20%20description%3A%20%7C%0A%20%20%20%20Random%20seed%20value%20for%20model%20initialization%20to%20ensure%20reproducible%20outputs.%0A%0A%20%20%20%20Setting%20a%20specific%20seed%20ensures%20that%20random%20operations%20within%20the%20model%20(like%20sampling)%0A%20%20%20%20produce%20the%20same%20results%20across%20different%20runs%2C%20which%20is%20important%20for%20reproducibility%0A%20%20%20%20in%20testing%20and%20development%20scenarios.%0A%20%20type%3A%20number%0A%20%20optional%3A%20true%0A%0A-%20name%3A%20useFp16ForKVCache%0A%20%20description%3A%20%7C%0A%20%20%20%20When%20enabled%2C%20stores%20the%20key-value%20cache%20in%20half-precision%20(FP16)%20format.%0A%0A%20%20%20%20This%20option%20significantly%20reduces%20memory%20usage%20during%20inference%20by%20using%2016-bit%20floating%0A%20%20%20%20point%20numbers%20instead%20of%2032-bit%20for%20the%20attention%20cache.%20While%20this%20may%20slightly%20reduce%0A%20%20%20%20numerical%20precision%2C%20the%20impact%20on%20output%20quality%20is%20generally%20minimal%20for%20most%20applications.%0A%20%20type%3A%20boolean%0A%20%20optional%3A%20true%0A%0A-%20name%3A%20tryMmap%0A%20%20description%3A%20%7C%0A%20%20%20%20Attempts%20to%20use%20memory-mapped%20(mmap)%20file%20access%20when%20loading%20the%20model.%0A%0A%20%20%20%20Memory%20mapping%20can%20improve%20initial%20load%20times%20by%20mapping%20model%20files%20directly%20from%20disk%20to%0A%20%20%20%20memory%2C%20allowing%20the%20operating%20system%20to%20handle%20paging.%20This%20is%20particularly%20beneficial%20for%0A%20%20%20%20quick%20startup%2C%20but%20may%20reduce%20performance%20if%20the%20model%20is%20larger%20than%20available%20system%20RAM%2C%0A%20%20%20%20causing%20frequent%20disk%20access.%0A%20%20type%3A%20boolean%0A%20%20optional%3A%20true%0A%0A-%20name%3A%20numExperts%0A%20%20description%3A%20%7C%0A%20%20%20%20Specifies%20the%20number%20of%20experts%20to%20use%20for%20models%20with%20Mixture%20of%20Experts%20(MoE)%20architecture.%0A%0A%20%20%20%20MoE%20models%20contain%20multiple%20%22expert%22%20networks%20that%20specialize%20in%20different%20aspects%20of%20the%20task.%0A%20%20%20%20This%20parameter%20controls%20how%20many%20of%20these%20experts%20are%20active%20during%20inference%2C%20affecting%20both%0A%20%20%20%20performance%20and%20quality%20of%20outputs.%20Only%20applicable%20for%20models%20designed%20with%20the%20MoE%20architecture.%0A%20%20type%3A%20number%0A%20%20optional%3A%20true%0A%0A-%20name%3A%20llamaKCacheQuantizationType%0A%20%20description%3A%20%7C%0A%20%20%20%20Quantization%20type%20for%20the%20Llama%20model's%20key%20cache.%0A%0A%20%20%20%20This%20option%20determines%20the%20precision%20level%20used%20to%20store%20the%20key%20component%20of%20the%20attention%0A%20%20%20%20mechanism's%20cache.%20Lower%20precision%20values%20(e.g.%2C%204-bit%20or%208-bit%20quantization)%20significantly%0A%20%20%20%20reduce%20memory%20usage%20during%20inference%20but%20may%20slightly%20impact%20output%20quality.%20The%20effect%20varies%0A%20%20%20%20between%20different%20models%2C%20with%20some%20being%20more%20robust%20to%20quantization%20than%20others.%0A%0A%20%20%20%20Set%20to%20false%20to%20disable%20quantization%20and%20use%20full%20precision.%0A%20%20type%3A%20LLMLlamaCacheQuantizationType%20%7C%20false%0A%20%20optional%3A%20true%0A%0A-%20name%3A%20llamaVCacheQuantizationType%0A%20%20description%3A%20%7C%0A%20%20%20%20Quantization%20type%20for%20the%20Llama%20model's%20value%20cache.%0A%0A%20%20%20%20Similar%20to%20the%20key%20cache%20quantization%2C%20this%20option%20controls%20the%20precision%20used%20for%20the%20value%0A%20%20%20%20component%20of%20the%20attention%20mechanism's%20cache.%20Reducing%20precision%20saves%20memory%20but%20may%20affect%0A%20%20%20%20generation%20quality.%20This%20option%20requires%20Flash%20Attention%20to%20be%20enabled%20to%20function%20properly.%0A%0A%20%20%20%20Different%20models%20respond%20differently%20to%20value%20cache%20quantization%2C%20so%20experimentation%20may%20be%0A%20%20%20%20needed%20to%20find%20the%20optimal%20setting%20for%20a%20specific%20use%20case.%20Set%20to%20false%20to%20disable%20quantization.%0A%20%20type%3A%20LLMLlamaCacheQuantizationType%20%7C%20false%0A%20%20optional%3A%20true"
